output.reason: The linked PR [ev-c717873ca6a1] makes the one-line note [ev-f66e20a1873d] concrete. It adds a referential-integrity check for user-defined RBAC roles, which requires at least one policy to give the role a permission. The check runs in `argocd admin settings rbac validate` and when the policy is loaded. The PR's changed files are in util/rbac [ev-10e44c188321]. Exposure is any RBAC policy that defines a role no policy references. The PR gives only a logged warning as the result, with nothing saying the policy is rejected, so the subject, who is exposed and the consequence (a warning only) can be written as typed fields.
